decisions.reason: The revision covers evaluative information as well as comments, with the retained trainer/presentation example selecting ordinary response information. Both selected passages show B2. The noun stays uncountable and separate from signal feedback or feed back.

The bounded schedule-change example selects ordinary authority-given allowance. Retain editorial A2 with Oxford A2 and Collins B1 preserved literally. This does not accept software access settings, written permission documents or consent validity.

The assigned-duty meaning is clear, and one of my responsibilities naturally illustrates a countable duty without adding a plural answer form. Collins assigned duties B2 supports the proposed course placement. Blame, liability and actual authority remain separate.

The welcome-pack example selects a concrete work item. Retain A2 supported by Oxford, with the Collins B2 disagreement explicit. Difficulty and membership of a larger project are not necessary conditions. Computing task processes are excluded.

The revised person-or-group definition accommodates a department while retaining organizational function. Collins B2 supports the placement; actor A2/B1+ evidence is excluded. Neither work titles nor this lexical acceptance establish authority or professional competence.

Retain the existing relative-importance definition and high-priority delivery example. Accept B2 as an independent editorial placement for comparison and work ordering, with no selected-source CEFR claim. Countable important-item B2 and traffic C2 are other senses; no operational priority policy is accepted.

The revision directly includes places where activities occur and matches meeting location. Accept editorial B1 using Oxford selected B1 while preserving Collins literal B1+ and its separate exact-position B2. Logical file or memory locations remain separate.

Postal or physical-location details can be spoken, so removing necessarily written improves precision. Retain the A2 course floor while preserving selected Collins A1. Electronic addresses and verbal address remain outside scope, and the ambiguous invitation expression stays held.

The retained characteristic written-name definition and form example match the ordinary noun. Collins B1 supports placement. Signing acts, stamps, electronic authentication, style and prescription senses receive no acceptance; no legal effect is inferred.

The retained shared-standard-time-region definition matches ordinary cross-location scheduling. Oxford selected B2 supports placement. Simplified 24-zone or universal one-hour-offset claims are excluded; no actual conversion or daylight-saving rule is approved.
